title: Continuous unit forms detect the measure: μ(W ∩ A) is approached by ∫_A v(φ) dμ (Lusin–Tietze–Urysohn step of Simon 6.2.8–2.9)
statement: Let P, k ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P, μ a Borel measure on ℝ^P with μ(K) < ∞ for every compact K ⊆ U, and v : ℝ^P → NVector (Eucl P) k with |v(x)(α)| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α for all x, α, x ↦ v(x)(α) Borel for every α, and such that for μ-a.e. x there is α with covectorEuclideanNorm α ≤ 1 and v(x)(α) = 1. Let A ⊆ ℝ^P be Borel, W ⊆ U open and c ∈ [0, ∞] with c < μ(W ∩ A). Then there is a continuous φ : ℝ^P → Covector (Eucl P) k with compact support, tsupport φ ⊆ W, covectorEuclideanNorm(φ(x)) ≤ 1 for all x, and c < ENNReal.ofReal(∫_A v(x)(φ(x)) dμ(x)).
lean_statement: ∀ (P k : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (μ : Measure (Eucl P)) (v : Eucl P → NVector (Eucl P) k), (∀ K : Set (Eucl P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μ K < ∞) → (∀ (x : Eucl P) (α : Covector (Eucl P) k), |v x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ α : Covector (Eucl P) k, Measurable (fun x => v x α)) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, ∃ α : Covector (Eucl P) k, covectorEuclideanNorm α ≤ 1 ∧ v x α = 1) → ∀ A : Set (Eucl P), MeasurableSet A → ∀ W : Set (Eucl P), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → ∀ c : ℝ≥0∞, c < μ (W ∩ A) → ∃ φ : Eucl P → Covector (Eucl P) k, Continuous φ ∧ HasCompactSupport φ ∧ tsupport φ ⊆ W ∧ (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm (φ x) ≤ 1) ∧ c < ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x in A, v x (φ x) ∂μ)
